comment: Sample images for the forensics tools, fetched by fetch-samples.py into samples/images (not in git). Licences as checked on each source page on 2026-09-27. Never add personal photos here.

files.name: sogndal-composite.jpg
files.author: Bjørn Erik Pedersen
files.what: photo composite: the big red quay building removed (Commons: "to illustrate how Sogndalsfjøra could look like without the big red building"), with parts of other photos

files.name: sogndal-original.jpg
files.author: Bjørn Erik Pedersen
files.what: the same place with the building, the photo the composite was made from (Pentax K-3 II, Lightroom)

files.name: pin-concealed.jpg
files.author: McGeddon
files.what: a PIN letter with a made-up number 2301 put in, derived from pin-original.jpg

files.name: pin-original.jpg
files.author: Mattes
files.licence: Public domain (PD-self: released by the author)
files.what: the PIN letter it was made from

files.name: ptz-montage.jpg
files.author: Andrew Krizhanovsky
files.licence: Public domain (PD-user: released by the author)
files.what: photomontage: a portrait with a rose and a double rainbow put into a street view (Petrozavodsk, 2012); the steps are in Commons category "Photomontage step by step"

files.name: yezhov-original.jpg
files.author: unknown photographer (1937)
files.what: Voroshilov, Molotov, Stalin and Yezhov at the Moscow Canal, 1937

files.name: yezhov-removed.jpg
files.author: unknown photographer (1937); retouched
files.what: the same photo after Yezhov was painted out (Soviet retouching, a scan of a print)

files.name: lincoln-calhoun-composite.jpg
files.author: unknown (1860s)
files.what: Lincoln's head on John Calhoun's body, a 19th-century composite print

files.name: kirksville-fake-tornado.png
files.author: unknown; scan by the Library of Congress
files.what: a faked tornado photograph of Kirksville, Missouri, 1899 (painted onto the print)

files.name: ribnica-lake-camera.jpg
files.author: Janezdrilc
files.what: camera JPEG, Nikon Coolpix L23, 2013: the photo the lake edits are made from

files.name: airplane-camera.jpg
files.author: Logan M Diel
files.what: camera JPEG, Kodak Z812 IS: the airliner that make-edits.py pastes into the lake sky

files.name: eggs-camera.jpg
files.author: safaritravelplus
files.what: photo, Canon EOS 250D (via safaritravelplus.com, licence reviewed on Commons): the egg edit is made from it

files.name: firefly-landscape.jpg

files.what: Adobe Firefly image with its Content Credentials
